name: rustab-frontend
description: Dev-only Tailwind CSS build tooling for the Rustab frontend. Nothing here ships at runtime; the Tailwind CLI is invoked via npx from Trunk.toml purely to generate CSS at build time. Tailwind v4 ships its standalone CLI as a separate package (@tailwindcss/cli), so both are declared here; the framework itself (tailwindcss) is pinned explicitly rather than left implicit as @tailwindcss/cli's transitive dependency, so the Tailwind version this app is built against is visible in this file.
